pattern: keep groups whose derived change is negative, null rounds drop out
question: list the districts where literate women percent is lower in NFHS-5 than in NFHS-4
gold_sql: SELECT "District" FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "District" <> 'State Total' GROUP BY "District" HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) < MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) ORDER BY "District"
sql_duckdb: SELECT "District" FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "State" = 'State Total' AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' AND "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" < (SELECT "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "State" = 'State Total' AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' AND "District" = "district_health_factsheet"."District")

attempts.response:
SELECT "District"
FROM "district_health_factsheet"
WHERE "State" = 'State Total'
  AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
  AND "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" < (
    SELECT "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)"
    FROM "district_health_factsheet"
    WHERE "State" = 'State Total'
      AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
      AND "District" = "district_health_factsheet"."District"
  );
